data.title: Armani Beach Residences
data.about:
Armani Beach Residences by Arada, situated in the prestigious Palm Jumeirah Dubai, is the final and last collaboration between Japanese architect Tadao Ando and fashion icon Giorgio Armani. This exclusive development promises an epitome of luxury living. 

It features three elegantly designed swimming pools, including a family-friendly option, and a tranquil private beach for ultimate relaxation. For health and fitness enthusiasts, there's a state-of-the-art two-story gym and a rejuvenating spa. The project comprises 53 boutique residences, offering a variety of 2 to 5-bedroom apartments, penthouses, and two top-floor presidential suites with rooftop access. Each residence is designed with a private entrance and a terrace, providing stunning views of the surroundings. Residents have the luxury of personalizing their homes with either light or dark color themes, ensuring their space reflects their personal style.

characteristics_module.title: The Ultimate Beach Living Experience:
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Branded Living by Armani: Residences fully furnished and styled by Armani/Casa, reflecting Giorgio Armani’s signature elegance.
  • Exclusive Waterfront Address: Positioned directly on the Palm’s beachfront with private beach access.
  • Architectural Masterpiece: A rare residential project designed by acclaimed architect Tadao Ando.
  • Limited Edition Residences: Ultra-luxury units with limited availability, ensuring exclusivity and privacy.
  • Bespoke Interiors: Choice of light or dark interior palettes with premium finishes and custom design elements.
  • Elevated Entry Experience: Dramatic ocean-facing arrival experience with water features and curated landscaping.
  • Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Living: Residences designed to maximize views and natural light with expansive terraces.
  • Five-Star Services: Access to world-class concierge, valet, and hospitality services managed to Armani standards.

location_tile.title: Live on the World’s Most Prestigious Manmade Island
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Armani Beach Residences Palm Jumeirah, built by Arada, will have beautifully designed homes, including a few penthouses and renowned entertainment and leisure attractions. These include The Lost Chambers Aquarium, Aquaventure Waterpark, Ain Dubai, as well as Dubai Marina Mall, The Walk at JBR, and The Beach at JBR.

Additionally, Downtown Dubai and Business Bay districts are just a half-hour drive away, while Dubai International Airport (DXB) is reachable within a 35-minute journey. Situated on the outer crescent of Dubai's iconic manmade islands, this project promises a lavish living experience that establishes a captivating and visually enchanting connection between each residence and the sea.

  • 10 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 15 Minutes to Mall of Emirates
  • 15 Minutes to Ain Dubai
  • 15 Minutes to Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 20 Minutes to Mall Of Emirates
  • 30 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 35 Minutes to Dubai Airport
